verdict.rationale: Ramp documents policy-driven auto-approval: submission requirements, spend limits, blocked merchants/categories set before spend, in-policy transactions auto-approved with GL coding and no expense report filed, and exception routing with recommended actions for humans to approve/reject; role- and team-based notification/permission workflows and per-category virtual card controls further support policy segmentation by role/context. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of auto-approval accuracy at scale and explicit fine-grained 'role AND context' policy matrix examples beyond marketing copy.
